notes:
Lead source: self-serve signup (trial credits used). Small e-comm support team building conversational FAQ assistant. Initial integration via Redwood JS SDK v0.9.3.

Discovery summary:
- 2026-02-20: sign-up + API key issued, ran smoke tests.
- 2026-02-23: inbound email from dev describing "sudden spikes" in response time (400-800ms).
- 2026-02-25: first call (Fireflies ff_20260301_1542) w/ dev lead (Alyssa). Walked through request patterns: mostly short chat turns, many system + user context ~600 tokens.
- 2026-03-01: customer performed regional test: EU (eu-west-1) avg 650ms. US-east-1 avg 180-240ms. Prefers eu for data locality but open to routing.

Technical notes / customer wants:
- Latency SLO target: <=200ms median for chat. Burst tolerance to 500ms.
- Throughput: tiny (10-30 rps), cost sensitive.
- Current model: open-llm-1 (curated), streaming enabled but client uses default 30s socket timeout.
- Observed: long system prompts, repeated context in every request -> token bloat. No caching of prefixes.
- SDK usage: default retry/backoff is aggressive; no explicit request timeout set in app (relying on SDK default).

Immediate recommendations provided on call:
- Try routing dev traffic to us-east-1 region to validate baseline latency (done; improved).
- Lower default socket timeout in client to 10s for chat endpoints to surface failures fast.
- Trim system prompt + dedupe user history; experiment with prefix caching (reuse system/context via conversation id).
- Reduce max_tokens for assistant when doing short Q/A. Encourage streaming to reduce perceived latency.
- Consider model variant with smaller context window/quantized weights for 1-2x cost savings.

Follow-up actions agreed:
- Jordan (SE) to run lightweight perf checklist with customer during 2026-03-08 tuning session.
- Provide sample SDK snippets: timeout config, streaming handler, prefix cache example. (drive://pricing_deck/harborcrest_trial_2026-02-25)
- Customer to run A/B for us-east-1 vs eu-west-1 for two days and report p95.

Quotable from dev: "Users notice the delay — even when answers are correct we lose conversions."

Open items / blockers:
- Must confirm whether EU data residency strict requirement (customer currently leaning to public cloud routing).
- Need clear token-cost estimate for trimmed prompts vs current baseline.
- No SSO / enterprise contract yet, slows procurement beyond trial.

Next meeting: 2026-03-08 11:00 ET (SE tuning call). Objective: reduce median latency under 250ms for sample flows, confirm region routing and provide quick config changes.
